verdict.rationale: Khoj is a self-hostable AI assistant server, so official SDKs are a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents only end-user clients (Emacs, Obsidian, desktop, web, WhatsApp) and LLM backend integrations (Ollama, LiteLLM), and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Nothing shows an official SDK that developers can build against.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
